pdf-extract 0.12.1 from crates.io (MIT, https://github.com/jrmuizel/pdf-extract), vendored for BrailleCraft's PDF
import. Changes, all in src/lib.rs, each marked with a "BrailleCraft:" comment:

- OutputDev gains five methods with default bodies, so other output devices are unchanged:
  - output_glyph: a character with its font's descent; by default it calls output_character. show_text now calls
    output_glyph.
  - begin_marked_content(tag, mcid) and end_marked_content: the BMC and BDC operators (with the MCID of a
    properties dictionary given inline; a property list named from the resources is not looked up, as pdfminer
    does not look it up) and the matching EMC. Tagged PDFs tie their structure tree to page content by these MCIDs.
  - begin_figure and end_figure around the content of a form XObject.
- Do runs only form XObjects; an image XObject was run as if its data were content operators.
- real_f64 (public): lopdf keeps real numbers as f32; every real is now taken as the f64 of its shortest decimal
  form, the number as the file wrote it, so positions match a reader that parses numbers in double precision
  (pdfminer). Used in as_num, the f64 FromObj, the TJ adjustment and the font descent.
- #![allow(warnings)] at the top: the upstream code's own warnings are not shown, as for a registry crate.
- PdfFont gains descent(), read from the font descriptor's Descent (for a composite font, from its first descendant
  font), in thousandths of the text size; 0 when there is none.

Known, unchanged: a form XObject's content starts from an identity matrix (its /Matrix and the page's current matrix
are not applied), and page /Rotate is not applied; BrailleCraft applies the page rotation itself.

Cargo.toml: the published dependencies only (the test-only dependencies and the release profile are left out), lopdf
pinned to the exact version 0.42.0.
LICENSE: the standard MIT text with the crate's author; the upstream repository has no license file.
